// Generated by explorer-proto/src/emit_session.ts from trace.json (discovered actions and locators) and
// sessions/bookmarks/charter.json (declared assertions). Do not edit by hand; re-run explore + emit --session=bookmarks.
// No pw.skipIfNoLicense() on purpose: this feature is licence-gated, but for this charter an unlicensed server is a
// setup failure, not a skip. Without a licence the declared bar assertions fail instead of being reported as skipped.

import {expect, test} from '@mattermost/playwright-lib';

import {closeGuardedSessions, openGuardedSession} from '../../../src/session';

test.afterEach(closeGuardedSessions);

/**
 * @objective Explore how the channel bookmark bar behaves when a signed-in regular member changes channel
 * in-app. Find out whether the bar shows only the current channel's bookmark in every state you reach, and never
 * keeps the previous channel's bookmark. Use only the allowlisted controls, and report each state's URL path and
 * the live accessible names of the bookmark links you see.
 * Hard expects only: a failing declared assertion stops the test at that line.
 */
test(
    'channels.bookmarks:bar-follows-switch: initial_bar then follows_switch',
    {tag: ['@channels', '@channel_bookmarks', '@explorer_session']},
    async ({pw}) => {
        const {page, channelsPage} = await openGuardedSession(pw);
        const bookmarkBar = page.getByTestId('channel-bookmarks-container');

        // # Go to /qa-team/channels/qa-sandbox (charter start.start_path, exploration start state s0f497e75)
        await channelsPage.goto('qa-team', 'qa-sandbox');

        // * Predicate initial_bar: declared (charter channels.bookmarks expected_outcome.initial_bar), discovered state s0f497e75
        await expect(page).toHaveURL((url) => url.pathname === '/qa-team/channels/qa-sandbox'); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks ib-1)
        await expect(bookmarkBar).toBeVisible(); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks ib-2)
        await expect(bookmarkBar.getByRole('link', {name: 'Sandbox runbook delta 2c71', exact: true})).toBeVisible(); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks ib-3)
        await expect(bookmarkBar.getByRole('link', {name: 'Sandbox runbook delta 2c71', exact: true})).toHaveCount(1); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks ib-3)
        await expect(page.getByRole('link', {name: /Release brief echo 5b90/})).toHaveCount(0); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks ib-4)

        // # Click link "release planning public channel" (discovered: trace #3, URL path changed to /qa-team/channels/release-planning)
        await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'release planning public channel', exact: true}).click();

        // * Predicate follows_switch: declared (charter channels.bookmarks expected_outcome.follows_switch), discovered state s553e62dd
        await expect(page).toHaveURL((url) => url.pathname === '/qa-team/channels/release-planning'); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks fs-1)
        await expect(bookmarkBar).toBeVisible(); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks fs-2)
        await expect(bookmarkBar.getByRole('link', {name: 'Release brief echo 5b90', exact: true})).toBeVisible(); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks fs-3)
        await expect(bookmarkBar.getByRole('link', {name: 'Release brief echo 5b90', exact: true})).toHaveCount(1); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks fs-3)
        await expect(page.getByRole('link', {name: /Sandbox runbook delta 2c71/})).toHaveCount(0); // declared (charter channels.bookmarks fs-4)
    },
);
